native.previewPolicy: No HTML/CSS approximations: the implementation is native Android. components contains native metadata; no browser-renderable snippets are asserted.

narrative.overview: A friendly personal training-club companion: bold condensed headings, cobalt action panels, coral and mint starter ideas, and readable native controls. The personality is energetic and approachable; everyday language and usable guidance come before optional AI configuration.
keyCharacteristics: Colorful Material surfaces with explicit light and dark palettes.
Condensed display type paired with system body text.
Real daily progress, short actions, expandable detail.

rules.name: The Paired Roles Rule
rules.body: Use each Material container with its corresponding on-color in the active theme; do not paste light-theme colors into dark screens.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use Barlow Condensed bold for display/headline roles and the unchanged Material system styles for titles, body copy and controls.

rules.name: The Tonal Grouping Rule
rules.body: Use colored containers for a distinct plan or starter group; use rows and dividers for repeated actions and guides.

dos: Do use semantic Material roles and the system-selected light or dark theme.
Do keep guide titles wrapping and preserve space for the Read/Close action.
Do show real completion counts and clear, reversible actions.
Do keep advanced AI and numeric photo detail collapsed until requested.
donts: Don't restore the retired ivory/forest minimal identity or old Analyze/Profile destination labels.
Don't introduce fictional scores, streaks or decorative dashboard metrics.
Don't make model setup a prerequisite for the daily plan, guides or local photo check.
Don't translate dp/sp into CSS pixels or claim the documentation proves accessibility or hardware performance.
